a.lede: Techniques included laptop infections, compromised internal tooling, and fake job interviews.
a.title: Binance says hackers who stole billions in crypto spent months planning heist

b.lede: An engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform and invited to bogus job interviews with fake company representatives, Binance says.
b.title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
